short: The XY model: BKT fine structure

title.title: Critical and near-critical XY scaling and BKT universality
title.subtitle: Claim: critical XY correlations decay as $r^{-1/4}(\log r)^{1/8}$, with the BKT essential singularity

beats.text: At the critical point the power law carries a slow logarithmic correction (curves schematic)
Near $\beta_c$ the correlation length blows up like $\exp(c/\sqrt{\beta_c - \beta})$

plain: Little compass needles on a grid melt into disorder through swirling vortices; how exactly does it happen?

steps: Trade the spins for a dual model of integer heights
Show those heights look like a Gaussian free field at large scales
Read the fine corrections off that Gaussian limit

voice.text: Compass needles on a grid. At criticality, correlations fade as a power, with a slow log.
Swap spins for integer heights, which look Gaussian at large scales.
